'''The Black Shores''' is a location in [[Solaris-3]]. The archipelago that makes up the Black Shores lies in the tempestuous Stormy Sea. Hidden by digital fog, it is inaccessible to any known lands without recognition or invitation of the [[Black Shores]] organisation which occupies it.
